fusions.name: Digging Spray
fusions.desc: Kicks loose earth back through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 4 earth damage with a 35% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Caved-In Footing
fusions.desc: Digs the ground from under the target and strikes, dealing 28 rock damage that ignores its armour and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone to Ground
fusions.desc: Veils you for 7 seconds and restores 10 health. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Grit Screen
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
